Subject: Request for residual-period attestation (post-SOC 2 report)

Hi Ava,

Thanks for sharing the SOC 2 Type II report earlier this month. Our security review flagged a residual coverage gap: your report period ended 2027-01-31 and our procurement compliance window is October 2027.

To proceed we need a short, signed attestation (sometimes called a residual-period or continuity letter) that confirms there have been no material changes to controls in-scope since the report end date or, if there were, a description of compensating measures. The letter can be short — 1 page plus signature is fine.

What we need:
- Statement covering the period 2027-02-01 through today (or until we finalize contract)
- Confirmation of no material control regressions or list of changes and mitigations
- Point of contact for follow-up and an estimated time to provide the letter

Can you confirm whether Red wood can provide this, and if so an ETA? If you have a standard template we can accept that as well.

Best,
Elaine Park
CISO, Cevalis Health
